scope: Corollary 15.9 (The outgoing graph-cover property) of the manuscript “Virtual compact specialness of hyperbolic one-relator groups” (preprints/Virtual-compact-specialness-of-hyperbolic-one-relator-groups-September-25-2026/paper.pdf), one of the manuscripts of result family 258 of openai/math at commit 1581d4cbdd69. The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 a6c45541e6943005), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF page 111. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. Finding the quote shows that the manuscript states it, not that it is true. AMVO has checked nothing about this claim.
statement: Let M be an incidence group embedded in a free actual row and represented by its finite Stallings core. A component LH of the cover determined by M0 may be required to have arbitrarily large prescribed girth. It has a nonempty finite family of connected cyclic ℓ-covers Lℓj, corresponding to Mℓj. The component LN determined by M ∩ N is exactly the cover whose fundamental group is the intersection of the covering kernels and the kernels of every additive first-cohomology class in the nontrivial deck part of each Lℓj, over the finite field ℸ with char ℸ ̸= ℓ. In particular, if e1, e2 are two lifts to Lℓj of the same oriented edge of LH, the pullback to LN of e∗ 1 − e∗ 2 has zero period on every closed path. All these statements are invariant under the required coset and conjugation changes.
